profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have extensive experience with full-stack web development, primarily on the LAMP stack. I've built numerous performant and maintainable custom web applications and business systems that have powered production ecommerce processes for years.

I enjoy and work with other languages and technologies as well, such as Go, Python, Docker, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, and Lua.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Inherited Senior Web Developer role and hired replacement Web Developer. Assumed significantly increased workload and responsibility.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Promoted to Web Developer and hired a replacement Web Designer. Took on more advanced development tasks.

positions.description: Hired on as Web Designer, but was quickly tasked with development work.
